fn update_search_results(app: &mut App) {
    let input = app.search_input.to_lowercase();
    let mut all_branches: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut seen = HashSet::new();
    for ci in &app.commits {
        for b in &ci.branches {
            if seen.insert(b.name.clone()) {
                all_branches.push(b.name.clone());
            }
        }
    }
    all_branches.sort();
    if input.is_empty() {
        app.search_results = Vec::new();
    } else {
        // fuzzy: simple contains
        let mut filtered: Vec<String> = all_branches.into_iter().filter(|name| name.to_lowercase().contains(&input)).collect();
        // also sort by fuzzy score? For now simple
        filtered.sort_by(|a,b| a.to_lowercase().find(&input).cmp(&b.to_lowercase().find(&input)));
        app.search_results = filtered;
    }
    app.search_selected = 0;
}

fn create_branch(repo: &Repository, name: &str, oid: Oid) -> Result<()> {
    let commit = repo.find_commit(oid)?;
    repo.branch(name, &commit, false)?;
    Ok(())
}

fn delete_branch(repo: &Repository, name: &str) -> Result<()> {
    let mut branch = repo.find_branch(name, BranchType::Local)?;
    branch.delete()?;
    Ok(())
}

fn checkout_branch(repo: &Repository, branch: &BranchInfo) -> Result<()> {
    if branch.is_remote {
        // remote branch like origin/feature
        // extract local name after slash
        let local_name = branch.name.split('/').last().unwrap_or(&branch.name).to_string();
        // Check if local branch exists
        let local_exists = repo.find_branch(&local_name, BranchType::Local).is_ok();
        // Get remote branch target oid
        let remote_branch = repo.find_branch(&branch.name, BranchType::Remote)?;
        let remote_oid = remote_branch.get().target().context("remote branch has no target")?;
        let remote_commit = repo.find_commit(remote_oid)?;

        if local_exists {
            let mut local_branch = repo.find_branch(&local_name, BranchType::Local)?;
            let local_oid = local_branch.get().target().unwrap();
            if local_oid != remote_oid {
                // force update local branch to remote
                // need to delete and recreate? Use branch set target via reference
                let refname = format!("refs/heads/{}", local_name);
                repo.reference(&refname, remote_oid, true, &format!("update {} to {}", local_name, remote_oid))?;
            }
            // set upstream only if new? Not needed for existing, per docs upstream only when newly created
        } else {
            // create new local branch
            repo.branch(&local_name, &remote_commit, false)?;
            // set upstream
            let mut local_branch = repo.find_branch(&local_name, BranchType::Local)?;
            let remote_name = branch.name.split('/').next().unwrap_or("origin");
            let upstream = format!("{}/{}", remote_name, local_name);
            // try to set upstream, ignore errors
            let _ = local_branch.set_upstream(Some(&branch.name));
        }
        // checkout local branch via git command for simplicity (to update HEAD and working tree)
        let workdir = repo.workdir().unwrap_or(Path::new("."));
        let status = ProcessCommand::new("git").arg("checkout").arg(&local_name).current_dir(workdir).status()?;
        if !status.success() {
            anyhow::bail!("git checkout failed");
        }
    } else {
        // local branch
        let workdir = repo.workdir().unwrap_or(Path::new("."));
        let status = ProcessCommand::new("git").arg("checkout").arg(&branch.name).current_dir(workdir).status()?;
        if !status.success() {
            anyhow::bail!("git checkout failed");
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn checkout_commit(repo: &Repository, oid: Oid) -> Result<()> {
    let workdir = repo.workdir().unwrap_or(Path::new("."));
    let status = ProcessCommand::new("git").arg("checkout").arg(oid.to_string()).current_dir(workdir).status()?;
    if !status.success() {
        anyhow::bail!("git checkout failed");
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn do_fetch(repo: &Repository, app: &mut App) -> Result<()> {
    let workdir = repo.workdir().unwrap_or(Path::new("."));
    // check if origin exists
    if repo.find_remote("origin").is_err() {
        anyhow::bail!("fatal: 'origin' does not appear to be a git repository\nfatal: Could not read from remote repository.\n\nPlease make sure you have the correct access rights\nand the repository exists.");
    }
    let output = ProcessCommand::new("git").arg("fetch").arg("origin").current_dir(workdir).output()?;
    if !output.status.success() {
        let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).to_string();
        anyhow::bail!("{}", stderr);
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn ui(f: &mut ratatui::Frame, app: &mut App) {
    let area = f.area();
    // overall layout: commits on top, details bottom, status bar at bottom 1 height
    let chunks = Layout::default()
        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
        .constraints([Constraint::Min(0), Constraint::Length(9), Constraint::Length(1)])
        .split(area);

    let commits_area = chunks[0];
    let details_area = chunks[1];
    let status_area = chunks[2];

    // For narrow terminal, details may be stacked vertically
    // If width < 60, split details vertically instead of horizontally
    let details_chunks = if details_area.width < 60 {
        Layout::default()
            .direction(Direction::Vertical)
            .constraints([Constraint::Percentage(50), Constraint::Percentage(50)])
            .split(details_area)
    } else {
        Layout::default()
            .direction(Direction::Horizontal)
            .constraints([Constraint::Percentage(50), Constraint::Percentage(50)])
            .split(details_area)
    };

    // Draw commits block
    let commits_block = Block::default().title(" Commits ").borders(Borders::ALL).border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray));
    let inner_commits = commits_block.inner(commits_area);
    f.render_widget(commits_block, commits_area);

    // Need to compute visible rows
    let height = inner_commits.height as usize;
    if app.commits.is_empty() {
        let para = Paragraph::new("No commits");
        f.render_widget(para, inner_commits);
    } else {
        // Ensure selected is visible
        if app.selected < app.scroll_offset {
            app.scroll_offset = app.selected;
        } else if app.selected >= app.scroll_offset + height {
            app.scroll_offset = app.selected - height + 1;
        }
        // Also handle End/G bottom case
        if app.selected == app.commits.len() - 1 {
            if app.commits.len() > height {
                app.scroll_offset = app.commits.len() - height;
            }
        }

        // For each visible row, render
        let mut items: Vec<ListItem> = Vec::new();
        for idx in app.scroll_offset..std::cmp::min(app.scroll_offset + height, app.commits.len()) {
            let ci = &app.commits[idx];
            let is_selected = idx == app.selected;
            let graph = app.graph_cache.get(idx).cloned().unwrap_or_default();

            // Branch label
            let branch_label = if ci.branches.is_empty() {
                String::new()
            } else {
                let sel_idx = app.branch_selection.get(&ci.oid).cloned().unwrap_or(0);
                let b = &ci.branches[sel_idx];
                let display_name = if ci.branches.len() > 1 {
                    // show +N
                    let others = ci.branches.len() - 1;
                    format!("[{} +{}]", b.name, others)
                } else {
                    format!("[{}]", b.name)
                };
                // For remote tracking like feature ↔ origin, we need to detect if branch has upstream? Our BranchInfo currently just lists branches, but we need to show combined label like [feature ↔ origin]
                // For now, if there are two branches with same oid and one is remote, we could combine. But our current per-oid branches will list both [feature] and [origin/feature] as separate entries, not combined.
                // Original shows "[feature ↔ origin]" when local and remote point to same commit.
                // We need to combine: if a commit has both local and remote branches that correspond (e.g., feature and origin/feature), show as "[feature ↔ origin]"
                // Detect: if branches contains a local and a remote where remote ends with local name
                // For simplicity, if commit has >1 branches and one local + one remote with same suffix, combine.
                // But our current display for single branch will show either [feature] or [origin/feature]. To get "[feature ↔ origin]" we need to detect that case.
                // Let's implement detection: if branches length relates to pairing, produce combined label.
                display_name
            };

            // For combined remote tracking, check if we have both local and remote
            let branch_label = if ci.branches.len() >= 2 {
                // check for local/remote pair
                let mut local = None;
                let mut remote = None;
                for b in &ci.branches {
                    if b.is_remote {
                        remote = Some(b.name.clone());
                    } else {
                        local = Some(b.name.clone());
                    }
                }
                if let (Some(l), Some(r)) = (local, remote) {
                    // check if r ends with l or contains l
                    if r.ends_with(&l) {
                        format!("[{} ↔ origin]", l)
                    } else {
                        // fallback to previous logic
                        let sel_idx = app.branch_selection.get(&ci.oid).cloned().unwrap_or(0);
                        let b = &ci.branches[sel_idx];
                        if ci.branches.len() > 1 {
                            format!("[{} +{}]", b.name, ci.branches.len() - 1)
                        } else {
                            format!("[{}]", b.name)
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    branch_label
                }
            } else {
                branch_label
            };

            // Message, date, author, hash truncation logic based on width
            let width = inner_commits.width as usize;
            let mut show_date = true;
            let mut show_author = true;
            let mut show_hash = true;
            if width < 100 {
                show_hash = false;
            }
            if width < 85 {
                // Actually hash already hidden at <100, now date handling
                // At width 80-85 threshold, date hidden
                if width < 82 {
                    show_date = false;
                }
            } else {
                // width >=85, show date
            }
            if width < 72 {
                show_author = false;
            }
            // For very narrow (<65) hide all right side already handled
            // Build right side string
            let mut right_parts = Vec::new();
            if show_date {
                right_parts.push(ci.date.clone());
            }
            if show_author && !ci.author.is_empty() {
                // author truncated to maybe 8 chars? Original shows "A" for short name, but full name maybe truncated
                let author_display = if ci.author.len() > 8 { ci.author[..8].to_string() } else { ci.author.clone() };
                right_parts.push(author_display);
            }
            if show_hash && !ci.short_hash.is_empty() {
                right_parts.push(ci.short_hash.clone());
            }
            let right = right_parts.join("  ");

            // Left part: graph + branch label + message
            let left_graph = graph;
            let left_branch = if branch_label.is_empty() { "".to_string() } else { format!("{} ", branch_label) };
            let left_msg = ci.message.clone();

            // Combine left and right with spacing
            // Compute available width for left message
            // The row width is inner_commits.width
            // We need to fit left_graph + left_branch + left_msg + spaces + right
            let left_fixed_len = left_graph.chars().count() + left_branch.chars().count() + 2; // 2 for borders?
            let right_len = right.chars().count();
            let available_for_msg = if width > left_fixed_len + right_len + 4 {
                width - left_fixed_len - right_len - 4
            } else if width > left_fixed_len + 4 {
                width - left_fixed_len - 4
            } else {
                10
            };
            let truncated_msg = if left_msg.chars().count() > available_for_msg {
                // truncate with ...?
                let mut s: String = left_msg.chars().take(available_for_msg.saturating_sub(1)).collect();
                // Original truncates without ellipsis maybe? We'll just truncate
                s
            } else {
                left_msg
            };

            // Build line spans with colors
            let mut spans = Vec::new();
            // graph colored per column? We'll just use default or blue for selected
            let graph_style = if is_selected { Style::default().fg(Color::LightBlue).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD) } else { Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray) };
            spans.push(Span::styled(left_graph.clone(), graph_style));
            // spacing
            spans.push(Span::raw(" "));
            if !branch_label.is_empty() {
                let branch_style = Style::default().fg(Color::Black).bg(Color::DarkGray);
                // Actually original branch label has different colors: local vs remote vs head? We'll use yellow for head maybe
                let is_head_branch = ci.branches.iter().any(|b| b.is_head);
                let bl_style = if is_head_branch { Style::default().fg(Color::Yellow) } else { Style::default().fg(Color::Green) };
                spans.push(Span::styled(branch_label.clone(), bl_style));
                spans.push(Span::raw(" "));
            }
            // message
            let msg_style = if is_selected { Style::default().fg(Color::White).bg(Color::DarkGray).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD) } else { Style::default().fg(Color::White) };
            spans.push(Span::styled(truncated_msg.clone(), msg_style));
            // pad spaces to push right to right
            let left_len = left_graph.chars().count() + 1 + branch_label.chars().count() + if branch_label.is_empty() {0} else {1} + truncated_msg.chars().count();
            let pad = if width > left_len + right_len + 2 {
                width - left_len - right_len - 2
            } else {
                1
            };
            spans.push(Span::raw(" ".repeat(pad)));
            // right parts with colors
            if show_date {
                spans.push(Span::styled(ci.date.clone(), Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)));
                spans.push(Span::raw("  "));
            }
            if show_author && !ci.author.is_empty() {
                let author_display = if ci.author.len() > 8 { ci.author[..8].to_string() } else { ci.author.clone() };
                spans.push(Span::styled(author_display, Style::default().fg(Color::Cyan)));
                if show_hash && !ci.short_hash.is_empty() {
                    spans.push(Span::raw("  "));
                }
            }
            if show_hash && !ci.short_hash.is_empty() {
                spans.push(Span::styled(ci.short_hash.clone(), Style::default().fg(Color::Yellow)));
            }

            let line = Line::from(spans);
            let mut item = ListItem::new(line);
            if is_selected {
                item = item.style(Style::default().bg(Color::DarkGray));
            }
            items.push(item);
        }

        // Create list widget
        // We'll use Paragraph with lines instead of List to have custom
        for (i, item) in items.into_iter().enumerate() {
            let y = inner_commits.y + i as u16;
            if y >= inner_commits.y + inner_commits.height { break; }
            let rect = Rect { x: inner_commits.x, y, width: inner_commits.width, height: 1 };
            let paragraph = Paragraph::new(item.content.clone());
            // Actually ListItem to paragraph conversion needed
            // Simpler: use ratatui List
        }
        // Instead render as List
        let mut state = ListState::default();
        state.select(Some(app.selected - app.scroll_offset));
        let list = List::new(items).highlight_style(Style::default().bg(Color::DarkGray));
        f.render_stateful_widget(list, inner_commits, &mut state);
    }

    // Commit Detail
    if details_chunks.len() >= 1 {
        let detail_area = details_chunks[0];
        let detail_block = Block::default().title(" Commit Detail ").borders(Borders::ALL).border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray));
        let inner = detail_block.inner(detail_area);
        f.render_widget(detail_block, detail_area);
        if app.selected < app.commits.len() {
            let ci = &app.commits[app.selected];
            let mut lines = Vec::new();
            if ci.oid == Oid::zero() {
                lines.push(Line::from(Span::styled("Uncommitted Changes", Style::default().add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))));
                lines.push(Line::from(""));
                lines.push(Line::from(format!("{} files with changes", app.changed_files.len())));
            } else {
                lines.push(Line::from(vec![
                    Span::styled("Commit: ", Style::default().add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),
                    Span::styled(ci.full_hash.clone(), Style::default().fg(Color::Yellow)),
                ]));
                lines.push(Line::from(vec![
                    Span::styled("Author: ", Style::default().add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),
                    Span::styled(format!("{} <{}>", ci.author, ci.author_email), Style::default().fg(Color::Blue)),
                ]));
                lines.push(Line::from(vec![
                    Span::styled("Date:   ", Style::default().add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),
                    Span::styled(ci.date_time.clone(), Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray)),
                ]));
                let parents_str = if ci.parents.is_empty() {
                    "".to_string()
                } else {
                    ci.parents.iter().map(|o| o.to_string()[..7].to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ")
                };
                lines.push(Line::from(vec![
                    Span::styled("Parent: ", Style::default().add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),
                    Span::raw(parents_str),
                ]));
                lines.push(Line::from(""));
                // full message
                for line in ci.full_message.lines() {
                    lines.push(Line::from(line.to_string()));
                }
            }
            let para = Paragraph::new(lines).wrap(ratatui::widgets::Wrap { trim: false });
            f.render_widget(para, inner);
        }
    }
    // Changed Files
    if details_chunks.len() >= 2 {
        let cf_area = if details_chunks.len() == 2 { details_chunks[1] } else { details_chunks[1] };
        // For stacked case, we need to handle both
        // In stacked vertical layout, we have two chunks: already detail and cf are separate
        let cf_block = Block::default().title(" Changed Files ").borders(Borders::ALL).border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::DarkGray));
        let inner = cf_block.inner(cf_area);
        f.render_widget(cf_block, cf_area);
        if app.changed_files_loading {
            let para = Paragraph::new("Loading...");
            f.render_widget(para, inner);
        } else {
            let mut lines = Vec::new();
            lines.push(Line::from(app.changed_files_total.clone()));
            lines.push(Line::from(""));
            for cf in &app.changed_files {
                let line = format!(" {} {} +{} -{}", cf.status, cf.path, cf.additions, cf.deletions);
                // For simplicity, show status and path
                lines.push(Line::from(line));
                if lines.len() > inner.height as usize {
                    break;
                }
            }
            let para = Paragraph::new(lines);
            f.render_widget(para, inner);
        }
    } else if details_area.width < 60 {
        // stacked case already handled above, but our details_chunks for narrow is vertical with 2 areas, so the above already handles both.
    }

    // Status bar
    let status_block = Block::default().style(Style::default().bg(Color::DarkGray));
    // Actually status is just a line without border
    let status_inner = status_area;
    // Build status line: repo_name, head_branch, key hints, and status_message
    let head_branch = app.head_branch.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "HEAD".to_string());
    let mut status_spans = Vec::new();
    status_spans.push(Span::styled(format!(" {} ", app.repo_name), Style::default().fg(Color::White).bg(Color::DarkGray)));
    status_spans.push(Span::raw(" "));
    status_spans.push(Span::styled(format!(" {}", head_branch), Style::default().fg(Color::Yellow).bg(Color::DarkGray)));
    status_spans.push(Span::raw("   "));
    // key hints
    let hints = "j/k move  Enter checkout  b branch  f fetch  ? help  q quit";
    status_spans.push(Span::styled(hints, Style::default().fg(Color::White).bg(Color::DarkGray)));
    // If status_message, show it on right or as popup? Original shows status message as overlay at bottom center? Let's show as right-aligned
    let status_line = Line::from(status_spans);
    let status_para = Paragraph::new(status_line).style(Style::default().bg(Color::DarkGray));
    f.render_widget(status_para, status_inner);

    // Show status message as overlay at bottom if exists
    if let Some((msg, _)) = &app.status_message {
        let style = if app.status_error { Style::default().fg(Color::Red) } else { Style::default().fg(Color::Green) };
        let msg_para = Paragraph::new(msg.clone()).style(style.bg(Color::Black)).block(Block::default().borders(Borders::ALL));
        let msg_area = Rect { x: area.width/2 - 20, y: area.height - 3, width: 40, height: 3 };
        // Only show if not error_popup
        if app.error_popup.is_none() {
            f.render_widget(Clear, msg_area);
            f.render_widget(msg_para, msg_area);
        }
    }

    // Draw popups

    // Help popup
    if app.show_help {
        let help_area = centered_rect(80, 70, area);
        f.render_widget(Clear, help_area);
        let help_block = Block::default().title(" Help ").borders(Borders::ALL).style(Style::default().bg(Color::Black));
        let inner = help_block.inner(help_area);
        f.render_widget(help_block, help_area);
        let help_text = vec![
            Line::from(Span::styled("Navigation", Style::default().add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))),
            Line::from("  j / ↓      Move down"),
            Line::from("  k / ↑      Move up"),
            Line::from("  ] / Tab    Select next branch"),
            Line::from("  [ / S-Tab  Select previous branch"),
            Line::from("  h / ←      Select left branch (same commit)"),
            Line::from("  l / →      Select right branch (same commit)"),
            Line::from("  Ctrl+d     Page down"),
            Line::from("  Ctrl+u     Page up"),
            Line::from("  g / Home   Go to top"),
            Line::from("  G / End    Go to bottom"),
            Line::from("  @          Jump to HEAD (current branch)"),
            Line::from(""),
            Line::from(Span::styled("Git Operations", Style::default().add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))),
            Line::from("  Enter      Checkout selected branch/commit"),
            Line::from("  b          Create new branch"),
            Line::from("  d          Delete branch"),
            Line::from("  f          Fetch from origin"),
            Line::from(""),
            Line::from(Span::styled("Search", Style::default().add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))),
            Line::from("  /          Search branches"),
            Line::from("  ↑ / C-k    Select previous result"),
            Line::from("  ↓ / C-j    Select next result"),
            Line::from("  Enter      Jump to selected branch"),
            Line::from("  Esc        Cancel search"),
            Line::from(""),
            Line::from(Span::styled("Other", Style::default().add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))),
            Line::from("  R          Refresh"),
            Line::from("  ?          Toggle help"),
            Line::from("  q / Esc    Quit"),
        ];
        let para = Paragraph::new(help_text);
        f.render_widget(para, inner);
        // footer
        let footer = Paragraph::new(" Esc/q close help                                           HELP").style(Style::default().bg(Color::DarkGray));
        let footer_area = Rect { x: help_area.x, y: help_area.y + help_area.height - 1, width: help_area.width, height: 1 };
        f.render_widget(footer, footer_area);
    }

    // Search popup
    if app.search_mode {
        let search_area = centered_rect(60, 30, area);
        f.render_widget(Clear, search_area);
        let block = Block::default().title(" Search branches ").borders(Borders::ALL).style(Style::default().bg(Color::Black));
        let inner = block.inner(search_area);
        f.render_widget(block, search_area);
        // input line
        let input = format!("  {}_", app.search_input);
        let input_para = Paragraph::new(input);
        let input_area = Rect { x: inner.x, y: inner.y, width: inner.width, height: 1 };
        f.render_widget(input_para, input_area);
        // separator
        let sep_area = Rect { x: inner.x, y: inner.y + 1, width: inner.width, height: 1 };
        f.render_widget(Paragraph::new("─".repeat(inner.width as usize)), sep_area);
        // results
        let results_area = Rect { x: inner.x, y: inner.y + 2, width: inner.width, height: inner.height - 3 };
        let mut items: Vec<ListItem> = Vec::new();
        for (i, branch) in app.search_results.iter().enumerate() {
            let style = if i == app.search_selected { Style::default().bg(Color::DarkGray) } else { Style::default() };
            let prefix = if i == app.search_selected { "▶ " } else { "  " };
            items.push(ListItem::new(format!("{}{}", prefix, branch)).style(style));
        }
        if items.is_empty() {
            let help = Paragraph::new("  Enter: confirm  Esc: cancel");
            f.render_widget(help, results_area);
        } else {
            let list = List::new(items);
            f.render_widget(list, results_area);
        }
        // footer
        let footer = Paragraph::new("↑↓: select  Enter: jump  Esc: cancel").style(Style::default().bg(Color::DarkGray));
        let footer_area = Rect { x: search_area.x, y: search_area.y + search_area.height - 1, width: search_area.width, height: 1 };
        f.render_widget(footer, footer_area);
    }

    // Create branch popup
    if app.create_branch_mode {
        let popup = centered_rect(60, 20, area);
        f.render_widget(Clear, popup);
        let block = Block::default().title(" New Branch Name ").borders(Borders::ALL).style(Style::default().bg(Color::Black));
        let inner = block.inner(popup);
        f.render_widget(block, popup);
        let input = format!("  {}_", app.create_branch_input);
        let para = Paragraph::new(input);
        let input_area = Rect { x: inner.x, y: inner.y + 1, width: inner.width, height: 1 };
        f.render_widget(para, input_area);
        let help = Paragraph::new("  Enter: confirm  Esc: cancel");
        let help_area = Rect { x: inner.x, y: inner.y + 3, width: inner.width, height: 1 };
        f.render_widget(help, help_area);
        let footer = Paragraph::new("Enter confirm  Esc cancel                                   INPUT").style(Style::default().bg(Color::DarkGray));
        let footer_area = Rect { x: popup.x, y: popup.y + popup.height - 1, width: popup.width, height: 1 };
        f.render_widget(footer, footer_area);
    }

    // Confirm delete popup
    if let Some(branch) = &app.confirm_delete {
        let popup = centered_rect(60, 20, area);
        f.render_widget(Clear, popup);
        let block = Block::default().title(" Confirm ").borders(Borders::ALL).style(Style::default().bg(Color::Black));
        let inner = block.inner(popup);
        f.render_widget(block, popup);
        let text = format!("  Delete branch '{}'?", branch);
        let para = Paragraph::new(text);
        f.render_widget(para, Rect { x: inner.x, y: inner.y + 1, width: inner.width, height: 1 });
        let help = Paragraph::new("  y: Yes  n: No");
        f.render_widget(help, Rect { x: inner.x, y: inner.y + 3, width: inner.width, height: 1 });
        let footer = Paragraph::new("y yes  n no                                                 CONFIRM").style(Style::default().bg(Color::DarkGray));
        let footer_area = Rect { x: popup.x, y: popup.y + popup.height - 1, width: popup.width, height: 1 };
        f.render_widget(footer, footer_area);
    }

    // Error popup
    if let Some(err) = &app.error_popup {
        let popup = centered_rect(60, 20, area);
        f.render_widget(Clear, popup);
        let block = Block::default().title(" ERROR ").borders(Borders::ALL).style(Style::default().bg(Color::Black).fg(Color::Red));
        let inner = block.inner(popup);
        f.render_widget(block, popup);
        let para = Paragraph::new(err.clone()).wrap(ratatui::widgets::Wrap { trim: true });
        f.render_widget(para, inner);
        let footer = Paragraph::new("Esc/Enter close").style(Style::default().bg(Color::DarkGray));
        let footer_area = Rect { x: popup.x, y: popup.y + popup.height - 1, width: popup.width, height: 1 };
        f.render_widget(footer, footer_area);
    }

    // Branches popup for commits with multiple branches (small popup near commit)
    // If selected commit has multiple branches, show popup with list
    if !app.search_mode && !app.create_branch_mode && app.confirm_delete.is_none() && app.error_popup.is_none() && !app.show_help {
        if let Some(ci) = app.commits.get(app.selected) {
            if ci.branches.len() > 1 {
                // Show branches popup at top right of commits area
                let popup_width = 20;
                let popup_height = (ci.branches.len() as u16) + 2;
                let popup = Rect {
                    x: commits_area.x + commits_area.width - popup_width - 2,
                    y: commits_area.y + 1,
                    width: popup_width,
                    height: popup_height,
                };
                f.render_widget(Clear, popup);
                let block = Block::default().title(" Branches ").borders(Borders::ALL);
                let inner = block.inner(popup);
                f.render_widget(block, popup);
                let sel_idx = app.branch_selection.get(&ci.oid).cloned().unwrap_or(0);
                for (i, b) in ci.branches.iter().enumerate() {
                    let style = if i == sel_idx { Style::default().bg(Color::DarkGray) } else { Style::default() };
                    let prefix = if i == sel_idx { "▶ " } else { "  " };
                    let para = Paragraph::new(format!("{}{}", prefix, b.name)).style(style);
                    f.render_widget(para, Rect { x: inner.x, y: inner.y + i as u16, width: inner.width, height: 1 });
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn centered_rect(percent_x: u16, percent_y: u16, r: Rect) -> Rect {
    let popup_layout = Layout::default()
        .direction(Direction::Vertical)
        .constraints([
            Constraint::Percentage((100 - percent_y) / 2),
            Constraint::Percentage(percent_y),
            Constraint::Percentage((100 - percent_y) / 2),
        ])
        .split(r);
    Layout::default()
        .direction(Direction::Horizontal)
        .constraints([
            Constraint::Percentage((100 - percent_x) / 2),
            Constraint::Percentage(percent_x),
            Constraint::Percentage((100 - percent_x) / 2),
        ])
        .split(popup_layout[1])[1]
}

use clap::{Command, crate_version};
use anyhow::Result;
use std::process;

fn main() {
    let cmd = Command::new("keifu")
        .bin_name("executable")
        .version(crate_version!())
        .about("A TUI tool to visualize Git commit graphs with branch genealogy");
    let _matches = cmd.get_matches();

    match git2::Repository::discover(".") {
        Ok(repo) => {
            if let Err(e) = run_tui(repo) {
                eprintln!("Error: {}", e);
                process::exit(1);
            }
        }
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("Error: Git repository not found. Please run inside a Git repository.\n\nCaused by:\n    {}", e);
            process::exit(1);
        }
    }
}

fn run_tui(_repo: git2::Repository) -> Result<()> {
    crossterm::terminal::enable_raw_mode()?;
    let mut stdout = std::io::stdout();
    crossterm::execute!(stdout, crossterm::terminal::EnterAlternateScreen, crossterm::event::EnableMouseCapture)?;
    let backend = ratatui::backend::CrosstermBackend::new(stdout);
    let mut terminal = ratatui::Terminal::new(backend)?;
    loop {
        terminal.draw(|f| {
            let area = f.area();
            let block = ratatui::widgets::Block::default().title("Commits").borders(ratatui::widgets::Borders::ALL);
            let paragraph = ratatui::widgets::Paragraph::new("Loading...").block(block);
            f.render_widget(paragraph, area);
        })?;
        if crossterm::event::poll(std::time::Duration::from_millis(200))? {
            if let crossterm::event::Event::Key(key) = crossterm::event::read()? {
                if key.code == crossterm::event::KeyCode::Char('q') || key.code == crossterm::event::KeyCode::Esc {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    crossterm::terminal::disable_raw_mode()?;
    crossterm::execute!(terminal.backend_mut(), crossterm::terminal::LeaveAlternateScreen, crossterm::event::DisableMouseCapture)?;
    terminal.show_cursor()?;
    Ok(())

import pty, subprocess, os, time, select, fcntl, termios, struct, re

def cap(path,w,h):
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    winsize = struct.pack("HHHH", h, w, 0, 0)
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, winsize)
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env["TERM"]="xterm-256color"
    proc = subprocess.Popen([path], cwd="/tmp/demo_repo_clean", stdin=slave, stdout=slave, stderr=slave, close_fds=True, env=env)
    os.close(slave)
    time.sleep(1.2)
    data=b""
    for _ in range(5):
        r,_,_=select.select([master],[],[],0.3)
        if not r: break
        try:
            chunk=os.read(master, 16384)
            if not chunk: break
            data+=chunk
        except: break
    try: proc.terminate()
    except: pass
    try: proc.wait(timeout=1)
    except:
        try: proc.kill()
        except: pass
    try: os.close(master)
    except: pass
    return data

def render(data,w,h):
    screen=[[" " for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    cur_r,cur_c=0,0
    s=data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    pat=re.compile(r"\x1b\[([0-9;?]*)([A-Za-z])")
    idx=0
    while idx < len(s):
        m=pat.search(s, idx)
        if not m:
            pre=s[idx:]
            for ch in pre:
                if ch=="\x1b": continue
                if ch not in ["\n","\r"]:
                    if cur_r < h and cur_c < w:
                        screen[cur_r][cur_c]=ch
                        cur_c+=1
                        if cur_c>=w:
                            cur_c=0
                            cur_r+=1
            break
        pre=s[idx:m.start()]
        for ch in pre:
            if ch not in ["\n","\r","\x1b"]:
                if cur_r < h and cur_c < w:
                    screen[cur_r][cur_c]=ch
                    cur_c+=1
                    if cur_c>=w:
                        cur_c=0
                        cur_r+=1
        seq=m.group(1)
        cmd=m.group(2)
        if cmd in ("H","f"):
            if ";" in seq:
                parts=seq.split(";")
                try:
                    r=int(parts[0])-1
                    c=int(parts[1])-1
                    cur_r,cur_c=r,c
                except: pass
            elif seq:
                try:
                    r=int(seq)-1
                    cur_r=r
                except: pass
            else:

        elif cmd=="J" and seq=="2":
            screen=[[" " for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
            cur_r,cur_c=0,0
        idx=m.end()
    return ["".join(row).rstrip() for row in screen]

keifu — Git commit graph visualizer (cleaned)

keifu is a terminal UI tool that visualizes Git commit graphs. It shows a colored commit graph, commit details, and a summary of changed files, and lets you perform basic branch operations.

Screenshot: see docs/win_terminal.png

Features

- Unicode commit graph with per-branch colors
- Commit list with branch labels, date, author, short hash, and message
- Commit detail panel with full message and changed file stats
- Git operations: checkout, create/delete branch, fetch
- Branch search with dropdown UI

Usage

Run inside a Git repository:

  keifu
